title: [observability] the Fleet page's strip and the scorecard's autonomy count the owner's posts in the queue as the Home card does (156's follow-up)
prompt:
Spawn, objective 158 [observability] (after 156): the Fleet page's strip and the scorecard's autonomy count the owner's posts in the queue as the Home card does. With 156, `/api/interventions` (the Home card, Core lines' observability.interventions_per_agent_hour) counts lead-mac's posts in the queue the ranges file names. /api/fleet's `health.human_per_agent_hour` (the Fleet page's strip, under the same name) and `spawn scorecard`'s autonomy are counted in SQL and do not. With the queue named, two numbers would stand under one name, the split 103 closed. Core line 3; the follow-up named in 156's prompt, scoped with projects-47 on 2026-11-14.

The queue setting: the live core-lines.json names no `observability.queue_file` until this lands. The lead sets it then, by hand, so Home, the guardrail, the Fleet strip and the scorecard move together.

Where things stand (156's throwaway at R1: ffda22f5 + 141 + 148 + 156 R1; 158's diff is the same on 156 R0 and R1, and touches no queue_posts.rs, so 156's day rule (R1, rev-f F1) carries over):
- crates/spawn-postgres/src/fleet.rs FLEET_HEALTH counts the day's interventions (`intervened`, from spawn_interventions) over the day's agent time (`live_ms`) into `human_per_agent_hour`, rounded half up to 3 decimals. It says `agent_hours_24h` but not the two parts.
- crates/spawn-cli/src/scorecard: autonomy is interventions per landing, from the History's marks (command, resume, owner_task, cancel_reassign), per scope (the fleet and each mission) and per window (the window, the previous one, each day).
- 156's queue_posts::items(settings, now, since, until) gives lead-mac's posts as items; serve/core_lines.rs queue_settings() reads the setting.

Read: crates/spawn-postgres/src/fleet.rs (FLEET_HEALTH), crates/spawn-cli/src/serve.rs (`fleet`), crates/spawn-cli/src/scorecard.rs (`measure`, the autonomy text line), scorecard/history.rs (Kind, Mark, History), scorecard/measure.rs (Counts, counts, autonomy), scorecard/interventions.rs, scorecard/queue_posts.rs.

Required behaviour.
- One ratio: scorecard/interventions.rs gains `pub(crate) fn per_agent_hour(total, agent_ms)` (3 decimals, half up; null with no agent time), and `answer` uses it.
- The strip:
  - FLEET_HEALTH says `interventions_24h` (intervened's n) and `agent_ms_24h` (live_ms, rounded to a whole ms), beside what it says today. No new table read; the same CTEs.
  - serve.rs `fleet`, when the ranges file names the queue: the posts in `[generated_at_ms − 24 h, generated_at_ms)`, placed by the wall clock as the Home card places them, are added (`add_queue_posts`): `interventions_24h` gains them, `queue_posts_24h` says how many, `human_per_agent_hour` is `per_agent_hour(interventions_24h, agent_ms_24h)`. With no queue named, nothing is added: the strip is the store's and has no `queue_posts_24h`.
- The scorecard:
  - Kind gains OwnerDecision and Steering; History gains `queue` and `queue_posts(items)`: each post a mark of the fleet's only (mission none), of its kind; any other item kind no mark.
  - scorecard.rs `measure`, when the queue is named, adds the posts over `[previous window's start, window's end)` before the clip, so the window, the previous one and the days all count them.
  - autonomy, when the queue is named (Counts.queue): `by_kind` gains owner_decision and steering, `interventions` and the value per landing count them. A mission's scope counts none and says them at 0. With no queue named, autonomy is as before (four kinds).
  - The text line (`spawn scorecard`) says the two kinds after the four when by_kind holds them.
- Nothing else changes: the Home card (156), the store, the ladder, every other figure and dimension, the web pages (they show by_kind as given).
- Polled read: /api/fleet is polled (the Fleet page). FLEET_HEALTH changes by two output keys from CTEs it already computes. `intervened` is now referenced twice, so Postgres may materialize it instead of inlining it. The lead timed it on live on 11-14 (sync/obj-158/fleet-health-before.sql and fleet-health-after.sql, explain analyze, read only, 3 runs each): before 60.1–82.8 ms execution (82.8 the cold first run), 8.3–8.8 ms planning; after 59.9–60.8 ms execution, 8.3–8.4 ms planning. No change: the second `intervened` reference costs nothing measurable. Cost PASS (projects-47). The queue's added cost is 156's: a stat and a scan of the kept text, read again only when the file changes.

Unit tests:
- crates/spawn-cli/src/scorecard/tests.rs `autonomy_counts_the_owners_queue_posts_for_the_fleet_only` (new): with mission 1's 3 landings and a resume, autonomy before the posts has its four kinds and 1 per landing (0.333). After an owner decision and a steering in the window, one steering outside it and a `command` item (no mark): the fleet's by_kind adds owner_decision 1 and steering 1, interventions 3, value 1.0; mission 1's interventions stay 1, owner_decision 0.
- spawn-postgres tests/experience.rs and the serve:: tests pass as they are; no test is renamed or dropped.
Each rule removed alone fails a test or the scenario.

Files: crates/spawn-postgres/src/fleet.rs (two keys), crates/spawn-cli/src/serve.rs (`fleet`, `add_queue_posts`), crates/spawn-cli/src/scorecard.rs (`measure`, the text line), crates/spawn-cli/src/scorecard/history.rs, crates/spawn-cli/src/scorecard/measure.rs, crates/spawn-cli/src/scorecard/interventions.rs (`per_agent_hour`; 156's file, written after it), crates/spawn-cli/src/scorecard/tests.rs, rsi/scenarios/158.sh (new). Two crates: spawn-postgres by the two keys only (the lead's word, 11-14).
The throwaway is +509 −12 on 156's throwaway:
- code about +119 −12: scorecard.rs +21 −7, history.rs +28, measure.rs +24, interventions.rs +12 −5, serve.rs +30, fleet.rs +4;
- tests: tests.rs +51;
- 158.sh +339.

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/158.sh. Black box through `spawn serve` and `spawn scorecard` on 156's seeded history and queue: 8 agent-hours in the day; mission 1 added, resumed 5 h ago, with 3 landings of Spawn's tasks 46 to 39 h ago (the previous day); a queue 8 h east of UTC with lead-mac's 4 posts in the day (2 owner decisions, 2 steering) and one 30 h ago, the lead's and a reviewer's not counted.
(1) /api/fleet's health: interventions_24h 5, queue_posts_24h 4, agent_ms_24h 28800000, human_per_agent_hour 0.625, the same as /api/interventions?window=24h's per_agent_hour.
(2) `spawn scorecard --since 24h --json`: the fleet's autonomy interventions 5 (the API's total), by_kind owner_decision 2, steering 2, resume 1; mission 1's interventions 1, owner_decision 0, steering 0; the fleet's previous is 0.333 (the post 30 h ago over the previous day's 3 landings). The text says "interventions 5: command 0, resume 1, owner_task 0, cancel_reassign 0, owner_decision 2, steering 2".
(3) With the ranges file naming no queue: the strip says interventions_24h 1, no queue_posts_24h, human_per_agent_hour 0.125; the scorecard's fleet autonomy is 1 with by_kind exactly cancel_reassign, command, owner_task, resume.
On the base (156's throwaway), 158.sh exits 1 with 7 checks failed, the first "(1) the Fleet strip counts the queue's posts: 5 interventions over 8 agent-hours: expected [{"interventions_24h":5,"queue_posts_24h":4,"agent_ms_24h":28800000,"human_per_agent_hour":0.625}], got [{"interventions_24h":null,…": the strip reads 0.125, autonomy has no queue kinds, the previous day reads 0.0, and (3) fails on the base only by its missing interventions_24h.
On the throwaway:
- 158.sh passes;
- the kept scenarios 017 (the scorecard's by_kind exactly), 049 (the scorecard against the API), 084, 100, 102, 103 (the strip is the Home card's) and 156 pass;
- the spawn-cli unit tests queue_posts, interventions::, scorecard:: and serve::tests, spawn-postgres's experience tests, cargo fmt --check and clippy -D warnings on both crates pass;
- the test list gains the new name, and none is missing.
13 mutants, each alone (mut158.py), each from a fresh copy, each built (13 distinct binaries), each run with the unit tests queue_posts, interventions:: and scorecard::tests and 158.sh:
- strip-not-added, strip-week (the posts of 7 days), strip-ratio-kept (the store's ratio kept), strip-no-agent-ms: (1); strip-no-store-count: (1), (3);
- card-not-wired, card-text-four (the text line's four kinds), card-window-only (the posts of the window only, not the previous one): (2);
- card-posts-on-mission (the posts on mission 1), card-sum-kept (interventions without them), card-value-kept (the value per landing without them): the unit test and (2);
- card-kinds-always (the queue's kinds with no queue named): two unit tests and (3);

Verified by: the gate runs 158.sh on the candidate. After the landing, with 156, the lead names the queue in the live core-lines.json, reads the Home card's figure, the Fleet strip's and the scorecard's fleet autonomy (by_kind owner_decision and steering) side by side with a hand count of the queue's lead-mac headings of the same 24 h, and posts them in sync.
rev-f reviews, after 156, so both are read together.
